subject: code:Presentation/Camera
looked_at: grep of TryGetComponent<IZoomSource> over Presentation (17 sites, 15 of them in Presentation/Camera)
docs/reference/tasks.md (the Camera and 'Tanks and walkers drawn' rows)

tasks.title: Read the zoom once a frame, in one place, not per event
tasks.why: Camera.main + TryGetComponent<IZoomSource> is written out 15 times under Presentation/Camera (CombatFx.cs:894 inside the per-burst recipe loop, CombatFx.Banks.cs:47, CombatFx.Barrage.cs twice, Bodies, HitBlood, ShellFire, Support, Abilities, FlipbookFx.FarFire.cs, TankRenderer.cs:1113), and twice more outside. CombatFx.Weapons.cs:10-11 already names the cost in the repo's own words: the same idiom ran 'for each of about sixty events a second', and it built ViewNow/ViewZoom (CombatFx.Weapons.cs:177-193) as the fix for the shot and hit paths only. The other sites still pay Camera.main (a tagged find) plus a GetComponent per event. ViewGround.cs:1-4 is the precedent for folding an idiom written out many times into one place.
tasks.done_when: A test in the shape of ViewGroundTests greps the presentation sources and fails when TryGetComponent<IZoomSource> appears outside the one frame-stamped reader; the 15 sites in Presentation/Camera are gone and the gate is green.

tasks.title: Ask one place which team is mine; stop hardcoding 0
tasks.why: TacticalCamera.cs:92 sums 'w.Team[i] == 0' into mineZ and every other team into theirsZ, and Along, the turn (side, line 97) and the pitch all hang off it. Seated as player 1 the standard view is inverted: you stand on the enemy side and the 21-degree turn goes the wrong way. Net/LoopbackTransport.cs:46 and ILockstepTransport.cs:21 hand out a LocalPlayer, so the seat already exists, and two other presentation files answer the same question their own way (QuietFog.cs:20 'public byte LocalTeam = 0', CombatFx.Mines.cs:24 'const int LocalPlayer = 0').
tasks.done_when: One presentation-side source answers 'which team is mine' (off the transport's LocalPlayer), the three sites read it, and an EditMode test with two teams on the field sets it to 1 and asserts Along flips (0 becomes 1) for the same Focus.

tasks.title: Test TacticalCamera's pure maths; it has none
tasks.why: tasks.md's Camera row says 'Tests: none' for TacticalCamera.cs and CameraShake.cs, yet their defaults ARE the owner's standard view (decisions.md 2026-09-21: fov 25, pitch 25, zoom 30) and are copied as bare constants into tests that do exist: Tests/Show/BannerFireFitTests.cs:174 (pitch 25, dist 30), UnitOneSizeTests.cs:16 (zoom 6/600), ViewGroundTests.cs:28 (pitch 8 = PitchMin). Change Pitch, Zoom or PitchMin and those premises go quietly false while every test stays green. The pieces are already pure enough to call: CloseUpAt (TacticalCamera.cs:107), Along and the wantYaw/wantPitch curve (92-105), CameraShake.Arrival and DistanceToLook (CameraShake.cs:38-46).
tasks.done_when: A new EditMode test in TW.Tests.Show asserts the standard-view defaults against decisions.md's numbers, CloseUpAt's 1-at-DetailFullZoom and 0-at-DetailGoneZoom ends, the side curve's three states, and Arrival(343) == 1; the tests that copy the constants read them from the component instead.

tasks.title: Two GoreScaleTests asserts restate the code, so cannot fail
tasks.why: GoreScaleTests.cs:63 asserts 1f + (Far - GoreScale.TrueUntilZoom) / GoreScale.GrowOver equals GoreScale.Size(Far) - the expected value is worked out the way Size works it out (GoreScale.cs:39), so any GrowOver keeps it green. Lines 74-77 assert Cap(share) == Sized(share, zoom) at zoom 600 and 10000 right after line 73 has asserted Size(zoom) == MostGrow; Sized is share*HeightM*Size and Cap is share*HeightM*MostGrow (GoreScale.cs:42,45), i.e. the same product twice. The file's header (line 8) claims these cases were red with the old numbers; only the neighbouring Greater/Less asserts actually hold the curve.
tasks.done_when: The two asserts use the measured numbers from the file's header (1.30 at zoom 120, the capped card in metres) instead of the formula; setting GrowOver to 600 in a scratch build turns the test red, and the gate is green with the real numbers.
